Store Policy

Transparency and Care

At The Heera our customers come first. We are committed to ensuring that your shopping experience is enjoyable and always on point. Our policies have been set to be fair, transparent, and worry-free.

Our Shipping Policy

We offer free shipping on all orders within India. All orders are processed and shipped within 1-2 business days and a tracking number will be provided once your order has been shipped. Standard shipping times vary depending on the state, but typically range from 3-7 business days for delivery within India. We take great care in packaging our products to ensure they arrive to you in perfect condition. If you have any questions or concerns about our shipping policies, please contact us directly.

Get In Touch
Return/Exchange Policy at THE HEERA

At our store, we strive to ensure customer satisfaction with every purchase.

Currently we do not offer any RETURN policy.

In case of size issue, we will gladly accept exchange within 4 days of delivery (only if the size is available). To initiate a exchange, please contact instagram team or email us for instructions.

Please note that we can only accept exchange for products that are in their original and unused condition. We will not accept exchange for used products.

Once we receive the returned item, we will inspect it and process your replacement. Please note that original shipping charges are non-refundable. The customer is responsible for return shipping charges.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in following our exchange policy.

Origin & Privacy at HEERA

Heera heels are proudly made in India. Our artisans with utmost care sew all the embellishments however ensuring longevity and high quality finished product.

In terms of our privacy policy, we are committed to protecting your personal information. We will only use the information you provide to us to process your order and to provide you with the best possible service. We will not share or sell your personal information to any third party. We only share your information with our trusted partners for the sole purpose of processing and delivering your order.

FAQ

We have compiled a list of some of the questions that we receive. If you still have something you’d like to know, don’t hesitate to contact us for more details. We will do our best to get back to you as soon as possible.

Q: What is The Heera's return policy?
A: At The Heera, we strive to ensure customer satisfaction with every purchase. If for any reason you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, we will gladly accept returns within 5 days of delivery. To initiate a return, please contact our customer service team for instructions. Please note that we can only accept returns for products that are in their original, unopened and unused condition. In the case that you receive a wrong size, we will provide a full refund or replacement. We will not accept returns for opened or used products except for the wrong or defective piece.
Q: How long will it take for my order to arrive from The Heera?
A: All orders are processed and shipped within 1-2 business days. Standard shipping times are typically 3-5 business days for delivery. Shipping times may vary depending on the destination and any unforeseen circumstances. If you have any questions or concerns about the status of your order, please contact our customer service team for assistance.
Q: Does The Heera offer returns on its products?
A. If for any reason you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, we will gladly accept returns within 3 days of delivery. In the case of receiving a wrong size , we will provide a full refund or replacement.
